_note: Tropical Florida Keys sandbox (DESIGN.md section 3). Pure play, no scoring, nothing can be done wrong. Plants grow with days (GameClock); watering only speeds them up. Every item shows by its 'label' (Florida.label): plants, recipes, and 'items' (things found, not grown or made). Recipes with a 'wear' block go on the paper doll; the rest are just made, kept and enjoyed. A critter 'surprise' fires when the doll's outfit matches 'when' (first match wins; the entry without 'when' is every critter's default, so every outfit gets a delighted reaction). 'lines' are spoken as the critter's bubble through Voice.speak; 'names' are the critters' cast ids in data/cast.json (set per placed critter as nickname; shown through Cast.short). 'gifts': the made things nobody wears can be given to the critters and the ponies, for friendship hearts and a small thing each kind does for a good friend (every gift is welcome).

gifts._note: Gifts (Florida.give): 'items' are the recipes without a 'wear' block, in the order the Give buttons show. Each critter (by its cast id nickname) and each pony (by its cast id) keeps its own friendship hearts, up to 'max_hearts'. A gift a kind lists under 'loved' earns hearts.loved, any other gift hearts.liked: every gift is welcome and gets a happy reaction. Only the first 'hearts_per_day' gifts of a GameClock day earn hearts for that friend; later ones that day are still taken happily. 'floats' are the float texts over the friend: 'heart' / 'hearts' for the hearts earned ({n}), 'unlocked' when the gift brings the unlock. 'lines' loved/liked/max are spoken for the gift ({item} is the gift's label; 'max' once the friend's hearts are full), 'effect' is the critter's tween for loved/liked (jump, spin, wiggle, hop, as surprises; flip is a leap with a spin; a pony has no 'effect', it hops whenever it speaks). 'unlock': once a friend has 'hearts' hearts, the gift panel (the stable panel, for a pony) shows a button 'label' that plays 'effect' and says one of 'lines'. Unlock ids: trick and bubbles (an effect and a line), follow (the crab walks beside you on its map until 'label_off' or you leave; 'lines_off' when it stays), shell (the gull brings one Shell a GameClock day; 'lines_none' later that day), nuzzle (a pony nuzzle, in the stable panel).
gifts._draft: Every line and button label under gifts is draft text for the author's approval.
